nodes.prompt:
Round 3 of 10 Evolutionary Multi-Agent Autonomous Orchestration:

Goal:
Implement Command Raw Stream Inspector, Subagent Lineage Call Tree, Error Stacktrace & Pushback Remediation Inspector, and Canvas Search Filter Overlay in GVUI.

Work Breakdown:
1. Task T-01: GVUI Command Raw Stream & Full Execution Log Inspector (`src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/CommandsTab.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/CommandDetailModal.tsx`)
   - Expandable modal/dialog for viewing full raw stream command records (`commands/<id>/record.json`), formatted stdout/stderr, execution duration, exit codes, and copy output.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

2. Task T-02: GVUI Subagent Lineage & Execution Call Tree (`src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/SubagentLineageTree.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/OverviewTab.tsx`)
   - Interactive hierarchical call tree in Overview Tab mapping parent coordinator -> subagents -> implementers/validators with status chips and click-to-jump node selection.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

3. Task T-03: GVUI Error Stacktrace & Pushback Remediation Inspector (`src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/FindingsTab.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/ErrorInspector.tsx`)
   - Deep inspection of pushback findings, structured stack traces, adversarial audit quotes, and before/after remediation patches with syntax coloring and copy actions.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

4. Task T-04: GVUI Canvas Interactive Search & Filter Overlay (`src/components/Toolbar/GraphSearchOverlay.tsx`, `src/components/Toolbar/index.tsx`, `src/engine/GraphCanvas/index.tsx`)
   - Live search filter overlay on the canvas allowing users to search nodes by label, role, archetype, or status, highlighting matches and panning to selected nodes.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/Toolbar && bun test src/engine/GraphCanvas`
